subject: prd/read-to-rule
statement: §0's informed-skip map shall name each content class §0 omits and the mechanism that backstops that class.
rationale: informed skipping is the honesty that separates routing from blind trust (brainstorm:gate-attention#D-2)
fit_criterion: the skip map is present in 100% of window §0s; every named class carries its backstop; at each sampled full read (FR-8), zero content classes found covered by the body but neither routed in §0 nor named in the skip map
